original_test_intent: Verify that each approved NVMe SSD, when inserted into its mapped backplane bay, produces the documented Present/power LED state without unexpected controller, storage or BMC errors.
original_method: A qualified operator performs supported insertion and captures physical LED state/timing, while the agent records stable serial-to-slot/controller mapping and complete read-only health/log evidence.
manual_activity: User approves LED semantics and insertion/data recovery; qualified operator inserts each NVMe and photographs the LED; agent collects secure read-only evidence only.
required_inputs: Platform Present/power LED state, color and timing
NVMe serial/WWN/NGUID to backplane slot/controller/HBA map
Supported hot-swap or powered-off service procedure
Qualified operator, camera, secure BMC/controller access and OOB
safety_requirements: Verify exact target and insertion support before physical action
Protect mounted/RAID/boot data and preserve baseline logs
Do not assume Locate or raw IPMI addresses the Present LED
Stop on wrong bay, resistance, enumeration mismatch, RAID/filesystem/thermal/power/BMC error or access loss
Do not reseat, rebuild, reboot or retry automatically
agent_execution_scope: Capture stable pre/post NVMe-slot-controller mapping and health
Collect complete OS/controller/BMC logs without clearing
Run only a documented secure read-only LED query if approved
Do not insert hardware, issue generic control, claim visual proof or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve target interpretation, mapping, LED specification and recovery
Provide operator and validate any vendor query semantics
Review physical plus system evidence and decide PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Enumeration can corroborate identity, but raw IPMI or Locate control tests a different path, uses unsafe access and cannot prove physical Present/power state.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use secure stable-ID/controller/enclosure and complete health/log capture around each operator insertion; only a vendor-documented read-only Present query may supplement photos.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All approved NVMe insertion, Present LED check and source 15/8 timing fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Correlate every timestamped physical Present/power observation with exact NVMe, slot, controller and complete system evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Rejects unsafe/non-equivalent control shortcuts and adds identity/safety traceability.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Automation corroborates but does not replace the literal physical NVMe LED checkpoint.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Combined indicator designs and platform-specific colors require the approved vendor state table.

project_override_considerations: If engineering intended rotating HDDs rather than the literal NVMe Procedure, that would require a new decision/variant; this review does not silently rewrite the source target.
expected_evidence: Operator identity, insertion timestamps and per-slot photos
Approved secure query output if any

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and Procedure consistently say NVMe Present LED; the Storage-HDD test-set grouping is broad labeling and does not require guessing a different target.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Mapping, LED spec and operator are supplyable prerequisites; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Preserves the literal NVMe target and makes every passive Present LED observation secure, identity-bound and physically auditable.
independent_technical_reasoning: Presence indication is triggered by occupancy/power state, whereas Locate is commanded and Access/Busy is activity-driven. Those paths may share optics but are not equivalent; therefore stable insertion identity and operator-visible state are primary, with controller/OS evidence only confirming discovery and health.
